description: Targets selected for SymCC feedback stabilization paired experiments. Ready targets have a target config, prebuilt SymCC configuration, and a static report suitable for dynamic-pairs.

targets.label: MRuby ARVO 57672 environment write-barrier UAF
targets.reason: Known complex lifecycle case used for feedback-stabilization smoke tests; has precise target_operation anchor and prebuilt source-location feedback map.

targets.label: ARVO 62290 SVC inter-layer prediction candidate
targets.reason: Previously exposed target-anchor, PIE/noise, and additional-crash issues; useful for testing failure-category and additional-finding handling.

targets.label: ARVO 38283 FreeRADIUS TACACS decoder
targets.reason: CyberGym/ARVO target with prebuilt SymCC binary and feedback map; broadens sample set beyond MRuby/libavc.

targets.label: ARVO 55020 binutils COFF AArch64 relocation
targets.reason: CyberGym/ARVO target with prebuilt SymCC binary and feedback map; exercises a different input domain and target codebase.

targets.label: Ghostscript TYPE 2 charstring operand stack
targets.reason: Useful case study, but current target config uses a manual/build-style SymCC setup rather than the stabilized prebuilt feedback contract; keep out of the first controlled dynamic-pairs batch.
